subject: Provisioning & acceptance checklist for evaluation materials
messages:
From: Laura Chen <lchen@veridian.ai>
To: vanessa_ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>
Cc: Tom Barnes <tom.barnes@veridian.ai>
Date: 2027-02-28T16:09:00Z
Subject: Re: Provisioning & acceptance checklist for evaluation materials

Hi Vanessa —

Thanks for the demo today. As discussed, we are ready to move forward with a short evaluation: we need a copy of the prompt pack, the representative testcases (approx 500 examples), and the dataset manifest so our engineering team can run acceptance tests.

Attached is our internal spec (Veridian_Eval_Specs_v1.docx) that outlines the metrics we'll run (precision-on-entities, instruction-following F1, and a hallucination spot-check). Two quick clarifications:

- We have an internal policy that any external assets used in evaluation must be ephemeral and removed from our systems after 30 days unless a longer retention is contractually approved.
- We need to confirm licensing: the assets must be limited to evaluation only, no further redistribution, and not used to train models at Veridian without express permission.

Can you share Redwood's standard MAP for asset provisioning and the format you prefer for the acceptance checklist? Also does Redwood watermark or provenance-tag testcases by default?

Thanks,
Laura Chen
Head of Product
Veridian.ai

Attachment: Veridian_Eval_Specs_v1.docx (document)

From: vanessa_ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>
To: Laura Chen <lchen@veridian.ai>
Cc: Tom Barnes <tom.barnes@veridian.ai>, karchik_ignored@redwood.com
Date: 2027-03-01T10:35:00Z
Subject: Re: Provisioning & acceptance checklist for evaluation materials

Laura —

Great to hear and thanks for sending the spec. I pulled together a concise mutual action plan and a provisioning checklist that maps to the items in your doc. High level:

1) Deliverables we will provide
   - Prompt pack (sample prompt set + README) — attached as a README stub (promptpack-sample-README.txt). Full prompt pack will be provisioned via a secure transfer.
   - Testcases (up to 500 examples) — delivered as ephemeral sandbox bundle.
   - Dataset manifest + provenance notes — included in the bundle.

2) Usage constraints we require (please confirm):
   - Evaluation-only license: assets may only be used for this defined acceptance evaluation. No redistribution or incorporation into training datasets without a signed addendum.
   - Ephemeral access window: default 30 days from provisioning; we can extend by mutual written agreement.
   - Audit logs: Redwood will provide checksums and a provenance manifest; Veridian must confirm deletion with a signed deletion certificate when evaluation ends.

3) Security & handling
   - Files will be delivered via an encrypted S3 presigned URL with IP restrictions or via our VPC private transfer for Dedicated customers.
   - We do not add watermarks to raw testcases by default. Instead we provide provenance metadata (source id, ingestion hash) and recommend ephemeral sandboxing. If Veridian requires embedded watermarking we can discuss an add-on.

I've attached our draft MAP (redwood_map_v1.pdf) that includes an acceptance checklist (ingestion steps, smoke tests, and deletion confirmation). Please review and flag any redlines. Once we align on terms, I can open an entry in HubSpot and initiate a DocuSign envelope for the MAP + evaluation license.

Next steps I propose:
- You and Tom review the attached MAP and the constraints above by EOD Wednesday (3/3).
- If acceptable, we prepare the prompt pack + ephemeral bundle and send a provisioning link the following week.

Would you like this routed through your legal team now or after we confirm the scope?

Best,
Vanessa Ortiz
Senior Solutions Manager
Redwood Inference

Attachments: redwood_map_v1.pdf, promptpack-sample-README.txt (stubs)

Subject: Re: Provisioning & acceptance checklist for evaluation materials

Looping in pricing/ops notes for the deal:

- For the ephemeral sandbox + secure transfer there is no additional fee for the first 30-day evaluation under standard trial terms. Any extension beyond 30 days will incur a nominal storage+egress surcharge (I recommend capturing this as a line item in the MAP to avoid surprises).
- If Veridian requests embedded watermarking or escrowed sample custody we should add a Professional Services line (estimate $4k).

Also recommend we ask Veridian to confirm: who will sign the deletion certificate (technical contact + legal). Marissa, can you slot this into the MAP PDF as an optional clause and create a short deletion-certificate template?

Karthik
Director, Enterprise Sales
Redwood Inference

(On internal thread — do not share pricing details with external until we have verbal acceptance.)
